d: Were Mughal queens really involved in secret love affairs, or were these stories just palace gossip and rumours? This episode of Tarikh explores the controversial stories surrounding Mughal royal women, including Jahanara Begum, Roshanara Begum, Qudsia Begum and Javed Khan. From Shah Jahan and Jahanara’s alleged relationship to Roshanara’s mysterious lovers and Qudsia Begum’s closeness with Javed Khan, we examine accounts by European travellers François Bernier and Niccolao Manucci, and the historical research behind these claims. Discover the truth behind Mughal history, the Mughal harem,…
